customer.shortDescription: A designer linear fireplace built by Travis Industries' DaVinci brand. Custom burners, custom glass — for commercial spaces and high-end homes.
bestFor: Customer who values custom design + visual presence

rep.verificationNotes: Selling DaVinci requires a customer who understands they're buying a design object, not a heat source. Always pair with a designer/architect conversation. Custom burners + custom glass = lead time and confirmation cycle.
rep.liamVoiceCallback: DaVinci — sold one to the Rockford Public Library; this exact unit. Commercial purposes mostly. Very high ticket, very high margin, very hard sell — because you just don't sell too often.
rep.crossSellNotes: If customer wants comparable visual without DaVinci price, walk to Kozy Heat Nordik 48TL (position 10) or Travis 4415HO linear (position 13).
rep.salesNotes: High-ticket, high-margin, low-volume. DaVinci is owned by Travis Industries. Designed for visual presence over heat. Cool-to-touch front (no screen). Strictly for looks — commercial purposes mostly, plus very wealthy residential.

internal.marginNotes: Per Liam: very high margin, very hard sell, low volume. Travis Industries family.
internal.recommendableStatusReason: High-value display; only recommend when customer profile fits luxury/commercial. Not for typical residential narrowing.

transcriptRefs.speaker: Speaker 3 (Drew)
transcriptRefs.quote: DaVinci is owned by Travis Industries. Strictly for looks. Is commercial purposes only, really. Some very, very wealthy people will get these in their home. Very high ticket. Very high margin. Very hard sell, because you just don't sell too often.
